numerics.dt_basis: first-order linearly implicit step. Agar: 1 ms vs 0.25 ms changes speed 0.2%. Water relaxes in ~0.2 ms, so 1 ms is 8% off the converged swim speed; 0.125 ms is ~1% off (BODY_TESTS.md numerics)
